# MTSamples Psychiatry corpus

These transcribed clinical-note samples come from MTSamples
(https://mtsamples.com), which makes its transcribed medical reports
freely available for educational and transcription-training use.

Source: https://mtsamples.com/site/pages/browse.asp?type=72-Psychiatry+/+Psychology
Fetched: 2026-05-24
Use here: integration-test fixtures for the Document AI OCR fallback
(THERAPY-ak6m.2.3). Each `.txt` file is one sample, rasterized at
fax-quality DPI by the test harness to exercise the scanned-PDF
fallback path against representative mental-health content.
